objectives.label: Catch {name} in the market at night, alive

title: The thief in the market
Catch the thief
summary: Theft is rife in {settlement}. The guard captain wants the market thief caught — alive.
offer: The stallholders are at my door every morning. There is a thief working the market at night, and the folk say the watch is asleep. Prove them wrong: catch the thief, alive, and bring back what they took.
complete: Caught! The court will deal with them. You have done the watch proud.
